_about: Bricked Sorting V14 shared interface, version 5. Wood structure + thin red PLA skin, resized body. Build to these numbers; request changes in your README under INTERFACE REQUESTS.
version: v14-interface-5 (2026-11-05 23:10): body 720 x 360 x 664, 2x2 + 1x2 wood frame and 1/2 in plywood floor and deck, 2 mm red PLA skin, 0.5 L bins at 79 pitch
axes: right-handed: origin = floor center; +Y toward the front (the front drawer pulls out +Y), +Z up, so +X is on the LEFT of a person facing the front drawer. Bin numbers follow the real viewer at each drawer.

wood.lumber: 2x2 (38 x 38 actual) for posts, 1x2 (19 x 38 actual) for rails and cleats; straight crosscuts only. Plywood 1/2 in (12 mm) floor and deck; the store cuts the sheet

beam_posts_1x2.note: vertical, between the short-wall bottom rail and deck cleat; the scoop beam screws into them

deck_ply.corner_notches: 38 x 38 at each corner around the posts (2 straight saw cuts per corner)

wood.screws: printed parts fasten to wood with #6 (3.5 mm) wood screws, 3.6 mm clearance holes; printed-to-printed with M3 inserts

skin.gap_to_wood: 4 mm for clips (skin inner face at x +-358 / y +-178)
skin.roof: 2 mm red PLA at z 612..614 resting on the top rails
skin.tiles: each <= 248 x 248; seams on the brick's natural lines; printed clips screw to posts and rails

studs.left_(-180): open ring, ID 200, the hopper sits inside; roof opening r 90

zones.F_frame_and_skin: the wood, the skin and clips, roof, studs, corner caps

D_drawers.rails: front drawer rails at x +-200 run back on the floor to y -40; back drawer rails at x +-120 run to y +40; rail zone z 12..38

S_scoop.note: minus the posts and beam posts; nothing below z 134 at any pose

plus: hopper inside the left stud up to z 664 through the roof opening
drop funnel: cylinder r 25 at (240, 0), z 270..312 through a deck hole r 28
K_deck.note: stay clear of the top rails (y +-155..174 / x +-335..354 at z 574..612) and the post corners

bin_ids.front: F1..F8, left to right as you face the front
bin_ids.back: B1..B8, left to right as you face the back
bin_ids.note: so B1 sits behind F8; numbering always reads left to right for the person at that drawer

side_marking: drawer faces in two filament colors (front and back), embossed F / B and 1-8 above each bin position, and a slide-in label card slot on each bin face for its category

drawer.note: travel 150 puts each bank's inner edge (y 55) at y 205, 25 past the skin, so bins lift straight out
drawer.runners: PETG rails on the drawer underside, 625ZZ floor stations screwed into the plywood (load pair + anti-lift pair per rail, guide rollers on one rail only), hard stops, closed detent
drawer.keying: front rails at x +-200, back at x +-120, so neither drawer fits the other side; a retaining bar holds the 8 bins
drawer.switches: one KW11-3Z drawer-closed switch per side

beam.section: closed PLA box ~50 tall x 30 deep, 3-4 keyed segments, joints off midspan
beam.mounts: end plates screwed into the 1x2 beam posts
beam.drive: salvaged NEMA17 + GT2 6 mm belt, 20T pulley, printed idler/tensioner, endstop at one end

scoop.suggested_geometry: shallow two-ended cup above a pivot at z ~200: lip ~85 out and ~20 up; dump at 40 deg -> lip y ~78, z ~157; opposite end rises to ~270, taper the ends; TPU pad
scoop.dump_rule: brick leaves the lip at |y| >= 75 and z >= 136 off a surface >= 40 deg
scoop.keepout_under_funnel: nothing from S inside r 32 of (240,0) above z 265
scoop.park: receive pose; drawers may open only when parked

drum: V13 drum as-is (47b 160 x 180 barrel with helical flight, 49b static plate); new cradles screw to the deck plywood
bought_parts_allowed: wood (2x2, 1x2, 1/2 in plywood), wood screws, paint optional; electronics, motors, servos, switches, LEDs, 625ZZ, GT2 belt + pulleys, M3/M5 hardware, M3 inserts, TPU/PTFE film

print_rules.source: Mnemosyne runbooks/3d-printing.md (read it first; its values beat anything here) and inventory/parts-owned.md for inserts
print_rules.estimates: grams with BJ's day profile: 0.4 nozzle, 0.2 layers, 4 walls, 15 % sparse infill, 3 bottom / 5 top layers; not solid volume
print_rules.fits_per_side: sliding/dovetail 0.065-0.07; press-fit pocket -0.02 (pocket smaller); loose drop-in 0.6 (bins); bearing pockets not yet measured on this printer: print a 625 coupon at 16.0/16.1/16.2 first
print_rules.inserts: M3 generic insert hole ~4.0-4.2 (verify with calipers), M5 Ruthex RX-M5x9.5 hole 6.4 min depth 10.5 min wall 2.6
print_rules.elephant_foot: 0.15 compensation is in BJ's profile; chamfer 0.6 on bed edges anyway
print_rules.budget: printed total <= ~9.5 kg and <= ~200 h (skin ~4.6 kg, studs ~0.5, mechanisms ~3.5, bins ~1)
print_rules.supports: none: overhangs <= 45 deg, bridges <= 30 mm, teardrop horizontal holes
print_rules.orientation: every part has a flat face on the bed; state it in parts.json
print_rules.materials: on hand: PLA (red for the body), PETG, ASA, TPU 95A, PC; AMS for multi-colour (labels, face numbers)
print_rules.file_back: after a test print, BJ's results go into the runbook (the main chat files them)

budget: printed total <= ~9.5 kg and <= ~200 h (skin ~4.6 kg, studs ~0.5, mechanisms ~3.5, bins ~1)
